const marked: { f(): number } & ThisType<{ value: number }> = {
  f() {
    return this.missing;
  },
};
const contextual: { f(): number } = {
  f() {
    return this.g();
  },
};
const nested: { inner: { f(): number } } & ThisType<{ k: number }> = {
  inner: {
    f: function () {
      return this.other;
    },
  },
};
const optional: { n: number; m(): number } | undefined = {
  n: 1,
  m() {
    return this.k;
  },
};
console.log(marked, contextual, nested, optional);
